children: OKXICE, a 50-50 joint venture between New York Stock Exchange owner Intercontinental Exchange and crypto exchange OKX, has filed with regulators to launch a tokenized stock-trading platform.

The company, co-chaired by former Governor of New York Andrew Cuomo and ICE Senior Vice President of Futures Markets Trabue Bland, is among the first to notify the SEC of its plan to launch a so-called tokenized securities venue.

Last month, the SEC cleared a path for trading venues to offer tokenized stocks in the U.S. via two five-year innovation exemptions. Under the guidelines, before a venue can begin trading any stock tokenized by a third party, it must give the issuing company 30 days notice. If the company objects, the venue can't proceed with the offering.
